rtk proxy sed -n '674,698p' tests/codegen/spl/filesystem.rs: escape` against the object when the call /// leaves them out — that is what `setCsvControl()` is for, and what the 8.4 deprecation text /// points at. elephc spelled `","` as the parameter default, so the state was ignored and /// `$f->setCsvControl(";"); $f->fgetcsv()` came back as one field. #[test] fn test_spl_file_object_csv_controls_fall_back_on_set_csv_control() { let (out, dir) = compile_and_run_in_dir( r#"<?php file_put_contents("ctl.csv", "a;b;c
"); $f = new SplFileObject("ctl.csv", "r"); $f->setCsvControl(";", """, "\"); echo json_encode($f->fgetcsv()), "|"; $g = new SplFileObject("ctl.csv", "r"); echo json_encode($g->fgetcsv(";", """, "\")), "|"; $h = new SplFileObject("ctl.csv", "r"); echo json_encode($h->fgetcsv(",", """, "\")), "
"; unlink("ctl.csv"); "#, ); assert_eq!(out, "["a","b","c"]|["a","b","c"]|["a;b;c"]
"); let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir); }
